Branching [canvasHistory.ts:392]
  saved parent: finalCheckpointId is the pinned source
    +-- fork(name)
    |     +-- child opens for editing
    +-- alternatives(names)
          +-- candidate A  same alternativeGroupId
          |     +-- A's descendant
          +-- candidate B  same alternativeGroupId
                +-- B's descendant
  keep(A)
    save A; archive its group siblings and their descendants
  discard(B)
    archive B and its descendants
  startGeneration(...)
    isolated candidates start at the parent's saved endpoint
    completed output adds a checkpoint to its child
